name: cloudaeye
description: Pre-commit code review, security scan, and task verification.

api_key.title: CloudAEye product API key
api_key.description: Optional — leave blank and run /cloudaeye:init instead, which signs you in through your browser and fills this in for you. Only needed if you already have a key from console.cloudaeye.com.

tenant_key.title: Tenant key
tenant_key.description: Optional — /cloudaeye:init fills this in. Only needed alongside a key you already have. Must be the tenant that key belongs to: it selects the database holding your repo integration, code-context graph and LLM configuration.

user_name.title: User name
user_name.description: Optional. Scopes review sessions so two developers working on the same repo don't share one.

url.title: Review server URL
url.description: Optional. Only needed for a self-hosted CloudAEye server.
